root.command: SELECT c.CustomerID, c.CompanyName, c.enabled, c.PredictionDisabled, cu.NextCoffeeBy, DateDiff("d", Now(), cu.NextCoffeeBy) AS DaysUntilNextCoffee FROM CustomersTbl AS c INNER JOIN ClientUsageTbl AS cu ON c.CustomerID = cu.CustomerID WHERE cu.NextCoffeeBy >= DateAdd("d", 6, Now()) AND cu.NextCoffeeBy <= DateAdd("d", 8, Now()) ORDER BY c.CompanyName

SELECT 'Total Updated (7 days out)' AS Category, COUNT(*) AS CustomerCount FROM ClientUsageTbl WHERE NextCoffeeBy >= DateAdd("d", 6, Now()) AND NextCoffeeBy <= DateAdd("d", 8, Now()) UNION ALL SELECT 'Enabled Customers' AS Category, COUNT(*) AS CustomerCount FROM CustomersTbl AS c INNER JOIN ClientUsageTbl AS cu ON c.CustomerID = cu.CustomerID WHERE cu.NextCoffeeBy >= DateAdd("d", 6, Now()) AND cu.NextCoffeeBy <= DateAdd("d", 8, Now()) AND c.enabled = True UNION ALL SELECT 'Disabled Customers' AS Category, COUNT(*) AS CustomerCount FROM CustomersTbl AS c INNER JOIN ClientUsageTbl AS cu ON c.CustomerID = cu.CustomerID WHERE cu.NextCoffeeBy >= DateAdd("d", 6, Now()) AND cu.NextCoffeeBy <= DateAdd("d", 8, Now()) AND c.enabled = False UNION ALL SELECT 'PredictionDisabled' AS Category, COUNT(*) AS CustomerCount FROM CustomersTbl AS c INNER JOIN ClientUsageTbl AS cu ON c.CustomerID = cu.CustomerID WHERE cu.NextCoffeeBy >= DateAdd("d", 6, Now()) AND cu.NextCoffeeBy <= DateAdd("d", 8, Now()) AND c.PredictionDisabled = True

SELECT 'With Active Recurring Orders' AS Category, COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID) AS CustomerCount FROM (CustomersTbl AS c INNER JOIN ClientUsageTbl AS cu ON c.CustomerID = cu.CustomerID) INNER JOIN ReoccuringOrderTbl AS ro ON c.CustomerID = ro.CustomerID WHERE cu.NextCoffeeBy >= DateAdd("d", 6, Now()) AND cu.NextCoffeeBy <= DateAdd("d", 8, Now()) AND ro.Enabled = True

SELECT 'No Email Address' AS Category, COUNT(*) AS CustomerCount FROM CustomersTbl AS c INNER JOIN ClientUsageTbl AS cu ON c.CustomerID = cu.CustomerID WHERE cu.NextCoffeeBy >= DateAdd("d", 6, Now()) AND cu.NextCoffeeBy <= DateAdd("d", 8, Now()) AND (c.EmailAddress IS NULL OR c.EmailAddress = '') AND (c.AltEmailAddress IS NULL OR c.AltEmailAddress = '')

SELECT 'With Orders in Next 9 Days' AS Category, COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID) AS CustomerCount FROM (CustomersTbl AS c INNER JOIN ClientUsageTbl AS cu ON c.CustomerID = cu.CustomerID) INNER JOIN OrdersTbl AS o ON c.CustomerID = o.CustomerID WHERE cu.NextCoffeeBy >= DateAdd("d", 6, Now()) AND cu.NextCoffeeBy <= DateAdd("d", 8, Now()) AND o.RoastDate >= Now() AND o.RoastDate <= DateAdd("d", 9, Now())

SELECT 'NULL NextDeliveryDate' AS Category, COUNT(*) AS CustomerCount FROM (CustomersTbl AS c INNER JOIN ClientUsageTbl AS cu ON c.CustomerID = cu.CustomerID) LEFT JOIN NextRoastDateByCityTbl AS nr ON c.City = nr.CityID WHERE cu.NextCoffeeBy >= DateAdd("d", 6, Now()) AND cu.NextCoffeeBy <= DateAdd("d", 8, Now()) AND nr.NextDeliveryDate IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'NextDeliveryDate in Past' AS Category, COUNT(*) AS CustomerCount FROM (CustomersTbl AS c INNER JOIN ClientUsageTbl AS cu ON c.CustomerID = cu.CustomerID) LEFT JOIN NextRoastDateByCityTbl AS nr ON c.City = nr.CityID WHERE cu.NextCoffeeBy >= DateAdd("d", 6, Now()) AND cu.NextCoffeeBy <= DateAdd("d", 8, Now()) AND nr.NextDeliveryDate < Now() UNION ALL SELECT 'NextDeliveryDate Outside Window' AS Category, COUNT(*) AS CustomerCount FROM (CustomersTbl AS c INNER JOIN ClientUsageTbl AS cu ON c.CustomerID = cu.CustomerID) LEFT JOIN NextRoastDateByCityTbl AS nr ON c.City = nr.CityID WHERE cu.NextCoffeeBy >= DateAdd("d", 6, Now()) AND cu.NextCoffeeBy <= DateAdd("d", 8, Now()) AND nr.NextDeliveryDate > DateAdd("d", 9, cu.NextCoffeeBy)

SELECT c.CustomerID, c.CompanyName, IIF(c.enabled = True, 'YES', 'NO') AS IsEnabled, IIF(c.PredictionDisabled = True, 'YES', 'NO') AS IsPredictionDisabled, IIF((c.EmailAddress IS NOT NULL AND c.EmailAddress <> '') OR (c.AltEmailAddress IS NOT NULL AND c.AltEmailAddress <> ''), 'YES', 'NO') AS HasEmail, IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ReoccuringOrderTbl ro WHERE ro.CustomerID = c.CustomerID AND ro.Enabled = True), 'YES', 'NO') AS HasRecurringOrders, IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM OrdersTbl o WHERE o.CustomerID = c.CustomerID AND o.RoastDate >= Now() AND o.RoastDate <= DateAdd("d", 9, Now())), 'YES', 'NO') AS HasRecentOrders, IIF(nr.NextDeliveryDate IS NULL, 'NULL', IIF(nr.NextDeliveryDate < Now(), 'PAST', IIF(nr.NextDeliveryDate > DateAdd("d", 9, cu.NextCoffeeBy), 'OUTSIDE', 'OK'))) AS DeliveryDateStatus, cu.NextCoffeeBy, nr.NextDeliveryDate FROM (CustomersTbl AS c INNER JOIN ClientUsageTbl AS cu ON c.CustomerID = cu.CustomerID) LEFT JOIN NextRoastDateByCityTbl AS nr ON c.City = nr.CityID WHERE cu.NextCoffeeBy >= DateAdd("d", 6, Now()) AND cu.NextCoffeeBy <= DateAdd("d", 8, Now()) ORDER BY c.CompanyName

SELECT c.CustomerID, c.CompanyName, c.EmailAddress, cu.NextCoffeeBy, nr.NextDeliveryDate FROM (CustomersTbl AS c INNER JOIN ClientUsageTbl AS cu ON c.CustomerID = cu.CustomerID) LEFT JOIN NextRoastDateByCityTbl AS nr ON c.City = nr.CityID WHERE cu.NextCoffeeBy >= DateAdd("d", 6, Now()) AND cu.NextCoffeeBy <= DateAdd("d", 8, Now()) AND c.enabled = True AND c.PredictionDisabled = False AND ((c.EmailAddress IS NOT NULL AND c.EmailAddress <> '') OR (c.AltEmailAddress IS NOT NULL AND c.AltEmailAddress <> '')) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ReoccuringOrderTbl ro WHERE ro.CustomerID = c.CustomerID AND ro.Enabled = True) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM OrdersTbl o WHERE o.CustomerID = c.CustomerID AND o.RoastDate >= Now() AND o.RoastDate <= DateAdd("d", 9, Now())) AND nr.NextDeliveryDate IS NOT NULL AND nr.NextDeliveryDate >= Now() AND nr.NextDeliveryDate <= DateAdd("d", 9, cu.NextCoffeeBy) ORDER BY c.CompanyName
